note: Backtest: predictions for the last 12 months of history (2025-01 to 2025-12) that the model did not see; not a forecast of future months. Quantities are in each material's own unit (uom); byPlantMonth adds across units, so use byUomMonth for unit-safe totals. series holds the 2,000 series with the largest actual volume (file-size cap); byPlantMonth and byUomMonth cover all 5,948 series.
